newsitem.title: UK: Brit Air to boost Gatwick services.
newsitem.headline: Brit Air to boost Gatwick services.

text.p: Brit Air of Morlaix, France, said it has boosted its Gatwick operation with a third daily service from London Gatwick to Nantes and the introduction of the Bombardier CRJ regional jet on the route.
The 50-seat regional jet, the first new generation short-haul jet aircraft, cuts flying time for the journey, previously operated by the ATR 42, from one hour 30 minutes to just 60 minutes.

"We see the introduction of the CRJ as a significant vote of confidence in our Gatwick operation," said Mike Johnson, general manager UK and Ireland. "Brest, Caen, Rennes, Le Harve, Rouen and Deauville are also operated throughout the winter, with Quimper added in the Summer." he added. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
